g.text: Class Diagram (Design) - AA02 External Identity Provider Integration (Google OIDC)
+verifyToken(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void>
AuthMiddleware and RoleMiddleware are reused unchanged
on protected routes (e.g. UserRoutes). The Google routes
are public: the user has no token yet.
Errors use AppError(message, status) and the existing
reused by AA07 for invited external accounts.
no role -> 403 "No active role is assigned to this account".
+resolveActor(token: string): Promise<{ sub: string, email: string, roles: string[] }>
issueAuthToken() is extracted from login() so local
and external sign-in issue the same AuthTokenDTO.
login() still compares against the dummy hash when there
is no local Password (uniform timing), and then rejects
+exchangeAndVerify(code: string, codeVerifier: string, nonce: string): Promise<ExternalIdentityClaims>
(state / nonce / PKCE verifier generated by the adapter)
consume() is single-use and ignores expired entries.
+generateToken(payload: { sub: string, email: string, roles: string[] }): string
+verifyToken(token: string): { sub: string, email: string, roles: string[] }
+createFromExternalIdentity(id: UserId, name: UserName, email: Email, identity: ExternalIdentity, consent: MarketingConsent): User
+create(provider: IdentityProvider, subject: string, linkedAt?: DateTime): ExternalIdentity
+exchangeAndVerify(code: string, codeVerifier: string, nonce: string): Promise<ExternalIdentityClaims>
iss, aud, exp and nonce; requires email_verified.
Google access token is discarded, never stored.
+generateToken(payload: { sub: string, email: string, roles: string[] }): string
+verifyToken(token: string): { sub: string, email: string, roles: string[] }
